checks.name: normal save retains bank and prior hook runs once only when actual save handler runs
stale cached picker is repaired at accepted opening then lazily rebuilds with original arguments
missing or partial unsafe picker retains complete existing cache and revision
unrecognized opening is preserved and cache retained despite old prefix later in script
exact whitelist cleanup preserves actor history, script callbacks, small tables and battle state
meal exact repeated bank compacts while mismatches, partial repeats and numeric payload survive
normal load/save retain bank; explicit clean is idempotent and never chains helper to itself

limitations: WASM invokes registered save-hook location using GS. Native before-save event timing and full game integration are root-owned.
No native process, original source/save writes, or runtime-speed claims.
